topic: Micrometer, descriptions of various parts, important terms such as backlash, measuring range, total error, cumulative error: various types
syllabus_extract: Micrometer, descriptions of various parts, important terms such as backlash, measuring range, total error, cumulative error: various types of Micrometers.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Micrometer parts identification, explanation of backlash and error terms, Instructor supervision of model handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a micrometer?
Name two other precision measuring instruments used in engineering.
Why is precision measurement critical in aircraft maintenance?

development.content:
Micrometer frame and anvil description
Sleeve and thimble scale markings
Ratchet stop and locking mechanism
Micrometer head assembly details

Definition and cause of backlash
Measuring range and span concepts
Total error calculation methods
Cumulative error accumulation effects

External micrometer types and uses
Internal micrometer variations
Depth micrometer applications
Selection criteria for micrometer types

summary_questions: Explain how backlash affects measurement accuracy.
Differentiate between total error and cumulative error.
Identify the correct micrometer type for measuring internal bores.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the care and handling of micrometers to be discussed in the next lesson on Slip Gauges.
